name: KineticPhrase
note: Baselines are regression references. A visual change re-writes them with --approve and needs critic approval (system rule).

critic.notes: Legible, token-disciplined, whole-word RTL phrase, stable layout, correct Arabic/shadda/BiDi. Non-blocking: size token 92 px exceeds 04 s3.2 56-80 px; stressed word (p50/p100 w3) glow indistinguishable; weak depth/light (hard-edged under-plate, no rim/bokeh); no mid-wipe strip so motion intent is code-verified only.
